01결론과 상태

선택 라이브러리 잔여 의미 18문구 교정

기존 한국어 자료 일곱 개의 지정된 18개 의미 교정과 근거를 재확인했다.

선별된 문구에 원문과 다른 의미가 있었고 부모 승인 및 과거 결과 기록을 계속 추적해야 했다. 검증 스크립트가 고정된 원문과 변경 전 지문, 현재 교정, 부모 작업의 변경 없는 승인과 실패 이력을 대조한다.

저장 당시 검사통과 18 · 실패 2 · 미확인 0건

보고서 자료 현재성 · 검사 유효성과 별개발행 시점 스냅샷

저장 당시 독립 검토당시 통과

저장 당시 업무 상태완료로 기록

일부 원본 항목이 이 보고서에 보관되지 않았습니다.

기준 근거 전체 40개 중 30개 표시 (10개 제외), 검사 이력 전체 25개 중 20개 표시 (5개 제외), 검토 이력 전체 15개 중 10개 표시 (5개 제외), 명령 인자 전체 94개 중 88개 표시 (6개 제외), 검토 지적 전체 25개 중 8개 표시 (17개 제외). 제외된 당시 기록 중 실패·차단·미확인 항목이 4건 있습니다. 더 넓은 기록은 근거의 작업 파일과 대조해야 합니다.

02문제와 접근

시작점

선별된 문구에 원문과 다른 의미가 있었고 부모 승인 및 과거 결과 기록을 계속 추적해야 했다.

접근과 결과

검증 스크립트가 고정된 원문과 변경 전 지문, 현재 교정, 부모 작업의 변경 없는 승인과 실패 이력을 대조한다.

기록에 남은 주요 선택

  • 부모 작업 전체 번역의 수용은 부모 기준에서 계속 판단한다.

03변경 결과

기록된 변경

  • 선별 문구 18개의 실제 교정과 현재 파일을 대조했다.
  • 라이브러리 무결성 중심 테스트를 실행했다.
  • 부모 작업 승인과 과거 실패 이력이 남아 있는지 확인했다.

요구와 결과

구조화된 요구·결과 설명이 없어 저장된 수용 기준과 당시 상태를 그대로 보여 줍니다.

고정 원문과 현재 SHA에 결속한 7개 기존 한국어 문서의 18개 실질 의미 차이를 선별 교정하고 다른 본문은 보존한다.
당시 통과로 기록
선택 자료 201개와 한국어186·원문15, 원문 해시·크기·고정 출처 및 법문을 유지하고 변경된 로컬 해시·크기만 inventory에 반영한다. 코드 표지 오역 한 건은 원문의 diff 식별자로 복원한다.
당시 통과로 기록
기존 W005 UUID와 실제 하위 저작·검증 근거를 관계로 연결하고 과거 실패와 승인 목록을 보존한다. 하위 작업의 PASS나 리뷰를 W005 완료로 복사하지 않는다.
당시 통과로 기록

구체적인 검증 대상·방법·기대·관측 설명이 기록되지 않았습니다. 명령이나 종료 코드만으로 사용자 행동을 확인했다고 추정하지 않습니다.

저장된 검사 이력의 당시 결과: 통과 18건, 실패 2건. 실제 프로세스 실행과 실제 모델·GUI·플랫폼 확인 범위는 각 검사 설명에서 구분합니다.

        "--input-type=module",
        "--eval",
        "\nimport assert from 'node:assert/strict';\nimport {readFile} from 'node:fs/promises';\nimport {createHash} from 'node:crypto';\nimport {readWork,authorizationDigest} from './scripts/workflow/work.ts';\nconst root=process.argv[1], childId=process.argv[2], parentId=process.argv[3], traceFile=process.argv[4];\nconst sha=value=>createHash('sha256').update(value).digest('hex');\nconst baseline=await readFile(root+'/baseline-proof.md','utf8');\nconst review=await readFile(root+'/current-review.md','utf8');\nconst heading=review.indexOf('## 18개실제교정과원문문맥');\nassert.notEqual(heading,-1);\nconst start=review.indexOf('{',heading), end=review.indexOf('\\n}',start);\nconst {patches}=JSON.parse(review.slice(start,end+2));\nassert.equal(patches.length,18);\nconst fence=String.fromCharCode(96).repeat(4);\nconst sections=new RegExp('^## (skill-library/[^\\\\n]+) — before SHA ([0-9a-f]{64})\\\\n\\\\n'+fence+'\\\\n(.*?)^'+fence+'$','gms');\nconst seen=new Set();\nlet applied=0;\nconst files=[];\nfor(const match of baseline.matchAll(sections)){\n const [,file,digest,display]=match;\n assert(!seen.has(file));\n seen.add(file);\n const actual=await readFile(file);\n let source=display;\n if(file.endsWith('/capy-pr.md')){\n  const displayed=source.split('\\n').find(line=>line.includes('[<caption>]'));\n  const literal=actual.toString('utf8').split('\\n').find(line=>line.includes('[<caption>]'));\n  assert(displayed&&literal&&displayed!==literal);\n  source=source.replace(displayed,literal);\n }\n const originals=[source,source.endsWith('\\n')?source.slice(0,-1):source];\n const original=originals.find(bytes=>sha(bytes)===digest);\n assert(original!==undefined,'교정 전 저장 지문과 다릅니다: '+file);\n let replaced=original;\n for(const patch of patches.filter(row=>row.path===file)){\n  assert.equal(patch.sha256,digest);\n  assert.equal(replaced.split(patch.old).length,2);\n  replaced=replaced.replace(patch.old,patch.new);\n  applied++;\n }\n assert.deepEqual(Buffer.from(replaced),actual,'현재 파일에 교정 이외 차이가 있습니다: '+file);\n files.push({file,beforeSha256:digest,currentSha256:sha(actual)});\n}\nassert.equal(seen.size,7);\nassert.equal(applied,18);\nconst evidence=JSON.parse(await readFile(traceFile,'utf8'));\nconst child=(await readWork({workId:childId})).record;\nconst parent=(await readWork({workId:parentId})).record;\nassert.equal(evidence.child,child.id);\nassert.equal(evidence.parent,parent.id);\nassert(child.relations.some(edge=>edge.type==='relates_to'&&edge.target===parent.id));\nassert.equal(authorizationDigest(parent.workflow.authorization),evidence.parentAuthorizationDigest);\nassert.deepEqual(parent.workflow.authorization.verifierCommands,evidence.parentApprovalCommands);\nassert(evidence.parentFailures.length>0&&evidence.childFailures.length>0);\nfor(const [work,list] of [[parent,evidence.parentFailures],[child,evidence.childFailures]]){\n const retained=new Set(work.workflow.verifications.filter(row=>row.result==='failed').map(row=>row.id));\n assert(list.every(id=>retained.has(id)));\n}\nconsole.log(JSON.stringify({applied,files,parent:parent.id,child:child.id,priorParentFailures:evidence.parentFailures.length,priorChildFailures:evidence.childFailures.length}));\n",

        "-e",
        "\nimport assert from \"node:assert/strict\";\nimport {execFileSync} from \"node:child_process\";\nimport {readFileSync} from \"node:fs\";\nimport {createHash} from \"node:crypto\";\nconst revision=process.argv[1];\nconst get=path=>execFileSync(\"git\",[\"show\",revision+\":\"+path]);\nconst hash=bytes=>createHash(\"sha256\").update(bytes).digest(\"hex\");\nconst inventory=\"skill-library/inventory.json\";\nconst sources=\"skill-library/sources.json\";\nassert.deepEqual(get(sources),readFileSync(sources));\nconst before=JSON.parse(get(inventory));\nconst after=JSON.parse(readFileSync(inventory));\nassert.equal(before.files.length,201);\nassert.equal(after.files.length,201);\nassert.equal(after.files.filter(file=>file.language===\"ko\").length,186);\nassert.equal(after.files.filter(file=>file.language===\"original\").length,15);\nconst current=new Map(after.files.map(file=>[file.localPath,file]));\nassert.equal(current.size,201);\nlet localChanged=0;\nfor(const beforeFile of before.files){\n const item=current.get(beforeFile.localPath);\n assert.ok(item,beforeFile.localPath);\n const {sha256:priorHash,bytes:priorBytes,...priorMetadata}=beforeFile;\n const {sha256:currentHash,bytes:currentBytes,...currentMetadata}=item;\n assert.deepEqual(priorMetadata,currentMetadata);\n const old=get(item.localPath);\n const contents=readFileSync(item.localPath);\n assert.equal(priorHash,hash(old));\n assert.equal(priorBytes,old.length);\n assert.equal(currentHash,hash(contents));\n assert.equal(currentBytes,contents.length);\n if(item.language===\"original\")assert.deepEqual(old,contents);\n if(priorHash!==currentHash)localChanged++;\n}\nconsole.log(JSON.stringify({revision,files:current.size,localChanged,originalFiles:15,koreanFiles:186,sourceMetadataUnchanged:true}));\n",

기준 근거 전체 40개 중 30개 표시 (10개 제외), 검사 이력 전체 25개 중 20개 표시 (5개 제외), 검토 이력 전체 15개 중 10개 표시 (5개 제외), 명령 인자 전체 94개 중 88개 표시 (6개 제외), 검토 지적 전체 25개 중 8개 표시 (17개 제외). 제외된 당시 기록 중 실패·차단·미확인 항목이 4건 있습니다. 더 넓은 기록은 근거의 작업 파일과 대조해야 합니다.

'./scripts/workflow/work.ts';\nconst root=process.argv[1], childId=process.argv[2], parentId=process.argv[3], traceFile=process.argv[4];\nconst sha=value=>createHash('sha256').update(value).digest('hex');\nconst baseline=await readFile(root+'/baseline-proof.md','utf8');\nconst review=await readFile(root+'/current-review.md','utf8');\nconst heading=review.indexOf('## 18개실제교정과원문문맥');\nassert.notEqual(heading,-1);\nconst start=review.indexOf('{',heading), end=review.indexOf('\\n}',start);\nconst {patches}=JSON.parse(review.slice(start,end+2));\nassert.equal(patches.length,18);\nconst fence=String.fromCharCode(96).repeat(4);\nconst sections=new RegExp('^## (skill-library/[^\\\\n]+) — before SHA ([0-9a-f]{64})\\\\n\\\\n'+fence+'\\\\n(.*?)^'+fence+'$','gms');\nconst seen=new Set();\nlet applied=0;\nconst files=[];\nfor(const match of baseline.matchAll(sections)){\n const [,file,digest,display]=match;\n assert(!seen.has(file));\n seen.add(file);\n const actual=await readFile(file);\n let source=display;\n if(file.endsWith('/capy-pr.md')){\n  const displayed=source.split('\\n').find(line=>line.includes('[<caption>]'));\n  const literal=actual.toString('utf8').split('\\n').find(line=>line.includes('[<caption>]'));\n  assert(displayed&&literal&&displayed!==literal);\n  source=source.replace(displayed,literal);\n }\n const originals=[source,source.endsWith('\\n')?source.slice(0,-1):source];\n const original=originals.find(bytes=>sha(bytes)===digest);\n assert(original!==undefined,'교정 전 저장 지문과 다릅니다: '+file);\n let replaced=original;\n for(const patch of patches.filter(row=>row.path===file)){\n  assert.equal(patch.sha256,digest);\n  assert.equal(replaced.split(patch.old).length,2);\n  replaced=replaced.replace(patch.old,patch.new);\n  applied++;\n }\n assert.deepEqual(Buffer.from(replaced),actual,'현재 파일에 교정 이외 차이가 있습니다: '+file);\n files.push({file,beforeSha256:digest,currentSha256:sha(actual)});\n}\nassert.equal(seen.size,7);\nassert.equal(applied,18);\nconst evidence=JSON.parse(await readFile(traceFile,'utf8'));\nconst child=(await readWork({workId:childId})).record;\nconst parent=(await readWork({workId:parentId})).record;\nassert.equal(evidence.child,child.id);\nassert.equal(evidence.parent,parent.id);\nassert(child.relations.some(edge=>edge.type==='relates_to'&&edge.target===parent.id));\nassert.equal(authorizationDigest(parent.workflow.authorization),evidence.parentAuthorizationDigest);\nassert.deepEqual(parent.workflow.authorization.verifierCommands,evidence.parentApprovalCommands);\nassert(evidence.parentFailures.length>0&&evidence.childFailures.length>0);\nfor(const [work,list] of [[parent,evidence.parentFailures],[child,evidence.childFailures]]){\n const retained=new Set(work.workflow.verifications.filter(row=>row.result==='failed').map(row=>row.id));\n         "\nimport assert from \"node:assert/strict\";\nimport {execFileSync} from \"node:child_process\";\nimport {readFileSync} from \"node:fs\";\nimport {createHash} from \"node:crypto\";\nconst revision=process.argv[1];\nconst get=path=>execFileSync(\"git\",[\"show\",revision+\":\"+path]);\nconst hash=bytes=>createHash(\"sha256\").update(bytes).digest(\"hex\");\nconst inventory=\"skill-library/inventory.json\";\nconst sources=\"skill-library/sources.json\";\nassert.deepEqual(get(sources),readFileSync(sources));\nconst before=JSON.parse(get(inventory));\nconst after=JSON.parse(readFileSync(inventory));\nassert.equal(before.files.length,201);\nassert.equal(after.files.length,201);\nassert.equal(after.files.filter(file=>file.language===\"ko\").length,186);\nassert.equal(after.files.filter(file=>file.language===\"original\").length,15);\nconst current=new Map(after.files.map(file=>[file.localPath,file]));\nassert.equal(current.size,201);\nlet localChanged=0;\nfor(const beforeFile of before.files){\n const item=current.get(beforeFile.localPath);\n assert.ok(item,beforeFile.localPath);\n const {sha256:priorHash,bytes:priorBytes,...priorMetadata}=beforeFile;\n const {sha256:currentHash,bytes:currentBytes,...currentMetadata}=item;\n assert.deepEqual(priorMetadata,currentMetadata);\n const old=get(item.localPath);\n const contents=readFileSync(item.localPath);\n assert.equal(priorHash,hash(old));\n assert.equal(priorBytes,old.length);\n assert.equal(currentHash,hash(contents));\n assert.equal(currentBytes,contents.length);\n if(item.language===\"original\")assert.deepEqual(old,contents);\n if(priorHash!==currentHash)localChanged++;\n}\nconsole.log(JSON.stringify({revision,files:current.size,localChanged,originalFiles:15,koreanFiles:186,sourceMetadataUnchanged:true}));\n",

        "\nimport assert from 'node:assert/strict';\nimport {readFile} from 'node:fs/promises';\nimport {createHash} from 'node:crypto';\nimport {readWork,authorizationDigest} from './scripts/workflow/work.ts';\nconst root=process.argv[1], childId=process.argv[2], parentId=process.argv[3], traceFile=process.argv[4];\nconst sha=value=>createHash('sha256').update(value).digest('hex');\nconst baseline=await readFile(root+'/baseline-proof.md','utf8');\nconst review=await readFile(root+'/current-review.md','utf8');\nconst heading=review.indexOf('## 18개실제교정과원문문맥');\nassert.notEqual(heading,-1);\nconst start=review.indexOf('{',heading), end=review.indexOf('\\n}',start);\nconst {patches}=JSON.parse(review.slice(start,end+2));\nassert.equal(patches.length,18);\nconst fence=String.fromCharCode(96).repeat(4);\nconst sections=new RegExp('^## (skill-library/[^\\\\n]+) — before SHA ([0-9a-f]{64})\\\\n\\\\n'+fence+'\\\\n(.*?)^'+fence+'$','gms');\nconst seen=new Set();\nlet applied=0;\nconst files=[];\nfor(const match of baseline.matchAll(sections)){\n const [,file,digest,display]=match;\n assert(!seen.has(file));\n seen.add(file);\n const actual=await readFile(file);\n let source=display;\n if(file.endsWith('/capy-pr.md')){\n  const displayed=source.split('\\n').find(line=>line.includes('[<caption>]'));\n  const literal=actual.toString('utf8').split('\\n').find(line=>line.includes('[<caption>]'));\n  assert(displayed&&literal&&displayed!==literal);\n  source=source.replace(displayed,literal);\n }\n const originals=[source,source.endsWith('\\n')?source.slice(0,-1):source];\n const original=originals.find(bytes=>sha(bytes)===digest);\n assert(original!==undefined,'교정 전 저장 지문과 다릅니다: '+file);\n let replaced=original;\n for(const patch of patches.filter(row=>row.path===file)){\n  assert.equal(patch.sha256,digest);\n  assert.equal(replaced.split(patch.old).length,2);\n  replaced=replaced.replace(patch.old,patch.new);\n  applied++;\n }\n assert.deepEqual(Buffer.from(replaced),actual,'현재 파일에 교정 이외 차이가 있습니다: '+file);\n files.push({file,beforeSha256:digest,currentSha256:sha(actual)});\n}\nassert.equal(seen.size,7);\nassert.equal(applied,18);\nconst evidence=JSON.parse(await readFile(traceFile,'utf8'));\nconst child=(await readWork({workId:childId})).record;\nconst parent=(await readWork({workId:parentId})).record;\nassert.equal(evidence.child,child.id);\nassert.equal(evidence.parent,parent.id);\nassert(child.relations.some(edge=>edge.type==='relates_to'&&edge.target===parent.id));\nassert.equal(authorizationDigest(parent.workflow.authorization),evidence.parentAuthorizationDigest);\nassert.deepEqual(parent.workflow.authorization.verifierCommands,evidence.parentApprovalCommands);\nassert(evidence.parentFailures.length>0&&evidence.childFailures.length>0);\nfor(const [work,list] of [[parent,evidence.parentFailures],[child,evidence.childFailures]]){\n const retained=new Set(work.workflow.verifications.filter(row=>row.result==='failed').map(row=>row.id));\n assert(list.every(id=>retained.has(id)));\n}\nconsole.log(JSON.stringify({applied,files,parent:parent.id,child:child.id,priorParentFailures:evidence.parentFailures.length,priorChildFailures:evidence.childFailures.length}));\n",

        "\nimport assert from \"node:assert/strict\";\nimport {execFileSync} from \"node:child_process\";\nimport {readFileSync} from \"node:fs\";\nimport {createHash} from \"node:crypto\";\nconst revision=process.argv[1];\nconst get=path=>execFileSync(\"git\",[\"show\",revision+\":\"+path]);\nconst hash=bytes=>createHash(\"sha256\").update(bytes).digest(\"hex\");\nconst inventory=\"skill-library/inventory.json\";\nconst sources=\"skill-library/sources.json\";\nassert.deepEqual(get(sources),readFileSync(sources));\nconst before=JSON.parse(get(inventory));\nconst after=JSON.parse(readFileSync(inventory));\nassert.equal(before.files.length,201);\nassert.equal(after.files.length,201);\nassert.equal(after.files.filter(file=>file.language===\"ko\").length,186);\nassert.equal(after.files.filter(file=>file.language===\"original\").length,15);\nconst current=new Map(after.files.map(file=>[file.localPath,file]));\nassert.equal(current.size,201);\nlet localChanged=0;\nfor(const beforeFile of before.files){\n const item=current.get(beforeFile.localPath);\n assert.ok(item,beforeFile.localPath);\n const {sha256:priorHash,bytes:priorBytes,...priorMetadata}=beforeFile;\n const {sha256:currentHash,bytes:currentBytes,...currentMetadata}=item;\n assert.deepEqual(priorMetadata,currentMetadata);\n const old=get(item.localPath);\n const contents=readFileSync(item.localPath);\n assert.equal(priorHash,hash(old));\n assert.equal(priorBytes,old.length);\n assert.equal(currentHash,hash(contents));\n assert.equal(currentBytes,contents.length);\n if(item.language===\"original\")assert.deepEqual(old,contents);\n if(priorHash!==currentHash)localChanged++;\n}\nconsole.log(JSON.stringify({revision,files:current.size,localChanged,originalFiles:15,koreanFiles:186,sourceMetadataUnchanged:true}));\n",

각 기록의 상태·검사·근거는 저장 당시의 관측입니다. 현재 상태를 다시 검증한 결과가 아닙니다.

일부 원본 항목이 이 보고서에 보관되지 않았습니다.

기준 근거 전체 40개 중 30개 표시 (10개 제외), 검사 이력 전체 25개 중 20개 표시 (5개 제외), 검토 이력 전체 14개 중 10개 표시 (4개 제외), 명령 인자 전체 94개 중 88개 표시 (6개 제외), 검토 지적 전체 23개 중 12개 표시 (11개 제외). 제외된 당시 기록 중 실패·차단·미확인 항목이 3건 있습니다. 더 넓은 기록은 근거의 작업 파일과 대조해야 합니다.

선별된 문구에 원문과 다른 의미가 있었고 부모 승인 및 과거 결과 기록을 계속 추적해야 했다. 검증 스크립트가 고정된 원문과 변경 전 지문, 현재 교정, 부모 작업의 변경 없는 승인과 실패 이력을 대조한다.

        "\nimport assert from 'node:assert/strict';\nimport {readFile} from 'node:fs/promises';\nimport {createHash} from 'node:crypto';\nimport {readWork,authorizationDigest} from './scripts/workflow/work.ts';\nconst root=process.argv[1], childId=process.argv[2], parentId=process.argv[3], traceFile=process.argv[4];\nconst sha=value=>createHash('sha256').update(value).digest('hex');\nconst baseline=await readFile(root+'/baseline-proof.md','utf8');\nconst review=await readFile(root+'/current-review.md','utf8');\nconst heading=review.indexOf('## 18개실제교정과원문문맥');\nassert.notEqual(heading,-1);\nconst start=review.indexOf('{',heading), end=review.indexOf('\\n}',start);\nconst {patches}=JSON.parse(review.slice(start,end+2));\nassert.equal(patches.length,18);\nconst fence=String.fromCharCode(96).repeat(4);\nconst sections=new RegExp('^## (skill-library/[^\\\\n]+) — before SHA ([0-9a-f]{64})\\\\n\\\\n'+fence+'\\\\n(.*?)^'+fence+'$','gms');\nconst seen=new Set();\nlet applied=0;\nconst files=[];\nfor(const match of baseline.matchAll(sections)){\n const [,file,digest,display]=match;\n assert(!seen.has(file));\n seen.add(file);\n const actual=await readFile(file);\n let source=display;\n if(file.endsWith('/capy-pr.md')){\n  const displayed=source.split('\\n').find(line=>line.includes('[<caption>]'));\n  const literal=actual.toString('utf8').split('\\n').find(line=>line.includes('[<caption>]'));\n  assert(displayed&&literal&&displayed!==literal);\n  source=source.replace(displayed,literal);\n }\n const originals=[source,source.endsWith('\\n')?source.slice(0,-1):source];\n const original=originals.find(bytes=>sha(bytes)===digest);\n assert(original!==undefined,'교정 전 저장 지문과 다릅니다: '+file);\n let replaced=original;\n for(const patch of patches.filter(row=>row.path===file)){\n  assert.equal(patch.sha256,digest);\n  assert.equal(replaced.split(patch.old).length,2);\n  replaced=replaced.replace(patch.old,patch.new);\n  applied++;\n }\n assert.deepEqual(Buffer.from(replaced),actual,'현재 파일에 교정 이외 차이가 있습니다: '+file);\n files.push({file,beforeSha256:digest,currentSha256:sha(actual)});\n}\nassert.equal(seen.size,7);\nassert.equal(applied,18);\nconst evidence=JSON.parse(await readFile(traceFile,'utf8'));\nconst child=(await readWork({workId:childId})).record;\nconst parent=(await readWork({workId:parentId})).record;\nassert.equal(evidence.child,child.id);\nassert.equal(evidence.parent,parent.id);\nassert(child.relations.some(edge=>edge.type==='relates_to'&&edge.target===parent.id));\nassert.equal(authorizationDigest(parent.workflow.authorization),evidence.parentAuthorizationDigest);\nassert.deepEqual(parent.workflow.authorization.verifierCommands,evidence.parentApprovalCommands);\nassert(evidence.parentFailures.length>0&&evidence.childFailures.length>0);\nfor(const [work,list] of [[parent,evidence.parentFailures],[child,evidence.childFailures]]){\n const retained=new Set(work.workflow.verifications.filter(row=>row.result==='failed').map(row=>row.id));\n assert(list.every(id=>retained.has(id)));\n}\nconsole.log(JSON.stringify({applied,files,parent:parent.id,child:child.id,priorParentFailures:evidence.parentFailures.length,priorChildFailures:evidence.childFailures.length}));\n",

        "\nimport assert from \"node:assert/strict\";\nimport {execFileSync} from \"node:child_process\";\nimport {readFileSync} from \"node:fs\";\nimport {createHash} from \"node:crypto\";\nconst revision=process.argv[1];\nconst get=path=>execFileSync(\"git\",[\"show\",revision+\":\"+path]);\nconst hash=bytes=>createHash(\"sha256\").update(bytes).digest(\"hex\");\nconst inventory=\"skill-library/inventory.json\";\nconst sources=\"skill-library/sources.json\";\nassert.deepEqual(get(sources),readFileSync(sources));\nconst before=JSON.parse(get(inventory));\nconst after=JSON.parse(readFileSync(inventory));\nassert.equal(before.files.length,201);\nassert.equal(after.files.length,201);\nassert.equal(after.files.filter(file=>file.language===\"ko\").length,186);\nassert.equal(after.files.filter(file=>file.language===\"original\").length,15);\nconst current=new Map(after.files.map(file=>[file.localPath,file]));\nassert.equal(current.size,201);\nlet localChanged=0;\nfor(const beforeFile of before.files){\n const item=current.get(beforeFile.localPath);\n assert.ok(item,beforeFile.localPath);\n const {sha256:priorHash,bytes:priorBytes,...priorMetadata}=beforeFile;\n const {sha256:currentHash,bytes:currentBytes,...currentMetadata}=item;\n assert.deepEqual(priorMetadata,currentMetadata);\n const old=get(item.localPath);\n const contents=readFileSync(item.localPath);\n assert.equal(priorHash,hash(old));\n assert.equal(priorBytes,old.length);\n assert.equal(currentHash,hash(contents));\n assert.equal(currentBytes,contents.length);\n if(item.language===\"original\")assert.deepEqual(old,contents);\n if(priorHash!==currentHash)localChanged++;\n}\nconsole.log(JSON.stringify({revision,files:current.size,localChanged,originalFiles:15,koreanFiles:186,sourceMetadataUnchanged:true}));\n",

        "\nimport assert from 'node:assert/strict';\nimport {readFile} from 'node:fs/promises';\nimport {createHash} from 'node:crypto';\nimport {readWork,authorizationDigest} from './scripts/workflow/work.ts';\nconst root=process.argv[1], childId=process.argv[2], parentId=process.argv[3], traceFile=process.argv[4];\nconst sha=value=>createHash('sha256').update(value).digest('hex');\nconst baseline=await readFile(root+'/baseline-proof.md','utf8');\nconst review=await readFile(root+'/current-review.md','utf8');\nconst heading=review.indexOf('## 18개실제교정과원문문맥');\nassert.notEqual(heading,-1);\nconst start=review.indexOf('{',heading), end=review.indexOf('\\n}',start);\nconst {patches}=JSON.parse(review.slice(start,end+2));\nassert.equal(patches.length,18);\nconst fence=String.fromCharCode(96).repeat(4);\nconst sections=new RegExp('^## (skill-library/[^\\\\n]+) — before SHA ([0-9a-f]{64})\\\\n\\\\n'+fence+'\\\\n(.*?)^'+fence+'$','gms');\nconst seen=new Set();\nlet applied=0;\nconst files=[];\nfor(const match of baseline.matchAll(sections)){\n const [,file,digest,display]=match;\n assert(!seen.has(file));\n seen.add(file);\n const actual=await readFile(file);\n let source=display;\n if(file.endsWith('/capy-pr.md')){\n  const displayed=source.split('\\n').find(line=>line.includes('[<caption>]'));\n  const literal=actual.toString('utf8').split('\\n').find(line=>line.includes('[<caption>]'));\n  assert(displayed&&literal&&displayed!==literal);\n  source=source.replace(displayed,literal);\n }\n const originals=[source,source.endsWith('\\n')?source.slice(0,-1):source];\n const original=originals.find(bytes=>sha(bytes)===digest);\n assert(original!==undefined,'교정 전 저장 지문과 다릅니다: '+file);\n let replaced=original;\n for(const patch of patches.filter(row=>row.path===file)){\n  assert.equal(patch.sha256,digest);\n  assert.equal(replaced.split(patch.old).length,2);\n  replaced=replaced.replace(patch.old,patch.new);\n  applied++;\n }\n assert.deepEqual(Buffer.from(replaced),actual,'현재 파일에 교정 이외 차이가 있습니다: '+file);\n files.push({file,beforeSha256:digest,currentSha256:sha(actual)});\n}\nassert.equal(seen.size,7);\nassert.equal(applied,18);\nconst evidence=JSON.parse(await readFile(traceFile,'utf8'));\nconst child=(await readWork({workId:childId})).record;\nconst parent=(await readWork({workId:parentId})).record;\nassert.equal(evidence.child,child.id);\nassert.equal(evidence.parent,parent.id);\nassert(child.relations.some(edge=>edge.type==='relates_to'&&edge.target===parent.id));\nassert.equal(authorizationDigest(parent.workflow.authorization),evidence.parentAuthorizationDigest);\nassert.deepEqual(parent.workflow.authorization.verifierCommands,evidence.parentApprovalCommands);\nassert(evidence.parentFailures.length>0&&evidence.childFailures.length>0);\nfor(const [work,list] of [[parent,evidence.parentFailures],[child,evidence.childFailures]]){\n const retained=new Set(work.workflow.verifications.filter(row=>row.result==='failed').map(row=>row.id));\n assert(list.every(id=>retained.has(id)));\n}\nconsole.log(JSON.stringify({applied,files,parent:parent.id,child:child.id,priorParentFailures:evidence.parentFailures.length,priorChildFailures:evidence.childFailures.length}));\n",

'./scripts/workflow/work.ts';\nconst root=process.argv[1], childId=process.argv[2], parentId=process.argv[3], traceFile=process.argv[4];\nconst sha=value=>createHash('sha256').update(value).digest('hex');\nconst baseline=await readFile(root+'/baseline-proof.md','utf8');\nconst review=await readFile(root+'/current-review.md','utf8');\nconst heading=review.indexOf('## 18개실제교정과원문문맥');\nassert.notEqual(heading,-1);\nconst start=review.indexOf('{',heading), end=review.indexOf('\\n}',start);\nconst {patches}=JSON.parse(review.slice(start,end+2));\nassert.equal(patches.length,18);\nconst fence=String.fromCharCode(96).repeat(4);\nconst sections=new RegExp('^## (skill-library/[^\\\\n]+) — before SHA ([0-9a-f]{64})\\\\n\\\\n'+fence+'\\\\n(.*?)^'+fence+'$','gms');\nconst seen=new Set();\nlet applied=0;\nconst files=[];\nfor(const match of baseline.matchAll(sections)){\n const [,file,digest,display]=match;\n assert(!seen.has(file));\n seen.add(file);\n const actual=await readFile(file);\n let source=display;\n if(file.endsWith('/capy-pr.md')){\n  const displayed=source.split('\\n').find(line=>line.includes('[<caption>]'));\n  const literal=actual.toString('utf8').split('\\n').find(line=>line.includes('[<caption>]'));\n  assert(displayed&&literal&&displayed!==literal);\n  source=source.replace(displayed,literal);\n }\n const originals=[source,source.endsWith('\\n')?source.slice(0,-1):source];\n const original=originals.find(bytes=>sha(bytes)===digest);\n assert(original!==undefined,'교정 전 저장 지문과 다릅니다: '+file);\n let replaced=original;\n for(const patch of patches.filter(row=>row.path===file)){\n  assert.equal(patch.sha256,digest);\n  assert.equal(replaced.split(patch.old).length,2);\n  replaced=replaced.replace(patch.old,patch.new);\n  applied++;\n }\n assert.deepEqual(Buffer.from(replaced),actual,'현재 파일에 교정 이외 차이가 있습니다: '+file);\n files.push({file,beforeSha256:digest,currentSha256:sha(actual)});\n}\nassert.equal(seen.size,7);\nassert.equal(applied,18);\nconst evidence=JSON.parse(await readFile(traceFile,'utf8'));\nconst child=(await readWork({workId:childId})).record;\nconst parent=(await readWork({workId:parentId})).record;\nassert.equal(evidence.child,child.id);\nassert.equal(evidence.parent,parent.id);\nassert(child.relations.some(edge=>edge.type==='relates_to'&&edge.target===parent.id));\nassert.equal(authorizationDigest(parent.workflow.authorization),evidence.parentAuthorizationDigest);\nassert.deepEqual(parent.workflow.authorization.verifierCommands,evidence.parentApprovalCommands);\nassert(evidence.parentFailures.length>0&&evidence.childFailures.length>0);\nfor(const [work,list] of [[parent,evidence.parentFailures],[child,evidence.childFailures]]){\n const retained=new Set(work.workflow.verifications.filter(row=>row.result==='failed').map(row=>row.id));\n 기준 근거 전체 36개 중 30개 표시 (6개 제외), 검사 이력 전체 23개 중 20개 표시 (3개 제외), 검토 이력 전체 12개 중 10개 표시 (2개 제외), 명령 인자 전체 76개 중 72개 표시 (4개 제외), 검토 지적 전체 22개 중 18개 표시 (4개 제외). 제외된 당시 기록 중 실패·차단·미확인 항목이 2건 있습니다. 더 넓은 기록은 근거의 작업 파일과 대조해야 합니다.

선별된 문구에 원문과 다른 의미가 있었고 부모 승인 및 과거 결과 기록을 계속 추적해야 했다. 검증 스크립트가 고정된 원문과 변경 전 지문, 현재 교정, 부모 작업의 변경 없는 승인과 실패 이력을 대조한다.

        "\nimport assert from \"node:assert/strict\";\nimport {execFileSync} from \"node:child_process\";\nimport {readFileSync} from \"node:fs\";\nimport {createHash} from \"node:crypto\";\nconst revision=process.argv[1];\nconst get=path=>execFileSync(\"git\",[\"show\",revision+\":\"+path]);\nconst hash=bytes=>createHash(\"sha256\").update(bytes).digest(\"hex\");\nconst inventory=\"skill-library/inventory.json\";\nconst sources=\"skill-library/sources.json\";\nassert.deepEqual(get(sources),readFileSync(sources));\nconst before=JSON.parse(get(inventory));\nconst after=JSON.parse(readFileSync(inventory));\nassert.equal(before.files.length,201);\nassert.equal(after.files.length,201);\nassert.equal(after.files.filter(file=>file.language===\"ko\").length,186);\nassert.equal(after.files.filter(file=>file.language===\"original\").length,15);\nconst current=new Map(after.files.map(file=>[file.localPath,file]));\nassert.equal(current.size,201);\nlet localChanged=0;\nfor(const beforeFile of before.files){\n const item=current.get(beforeFile.localPath);\n assert.ok(item,beforeFile.localPath);\n const {sha256:priorHash,bytes:priorBytes,...priorMetadata}=beforeFile;\n const {sha256:currentHash,bytes:currentBytes,...currentMetadata}=item;\n assert.deepEqual(priorMetadata,currentMetadata);\n const old=get(item.localPath);\n const contents=readFileSync(item.localPath);\n assert.equal(priorHash,hash(old));\n assert.equal(priorBytes,old.length);\n assert.equal(currentHash,hash(contents));\n assert.equal(currentBytes,contents.length);\n if(item.language===\"original\")assert.deepEqual(old,contents);\n if(priorHash!==currentHash)localChanged++;\n}\nconsole.log(JSON.stringify({revision,files:current.size,localChanged,originalFiles:15,koreanFiles:186,sourceMetadataUnchanged:true}));\n",

        "-e",
        "\nimport assert from \"node:assert/strict\";\nimport {execFileSync} from \"node:child_process\";\nimport {readFileSync} from \"node:fs\";\nimport {createHash} from \"node:crypto\";\nconst revision=process.argv[1];\nconst get=path=>execFileSync(\"git\",[\"show\",revision+\":\"+path]);\nconst hash=bytes=>createHash(\"sha256\").update(bytes).digest(\"hex\");\nconst inventory=\"skill-library/inventory.json\";\nconst sources=\"skill-library/sources.json\";\nassert.deepEqual(get(sources),readFileSync(sources));\nconst before=JSON.parse(get(inventory));\nconst after=JSON.parse(readFileSync(inventory));\nassert.equal(before.files.length,201);\nassert.equal(after.files.length,201);\nassert.equal(after.files.filter(file=>file.language===\"ko\").length,186);\nassert.equal(after.files.filter(file=>file.language===\"original\").length,15);\nconst current=new Map(after.files.map(file=>[file.localPath,file]));\nassert.equal(current.size,201);\nlet localChanged=0;\nfor(const beforeFile of before.files){\n const item=current.get(beforeFile.localPath);\n assert.ok(item,beforeFile.localPath);\n const {sha256:priorHash,bytes:priorBytes,...priorMetadata}=beforeFile;\n const {sha256:currentHash,bytes:currentBytes,...currentMetadata}=item;\n assert.deepEqual(priorMetadata,currentMetadata);\n const old=get(item.localPath);\n const contents=readFileSync(item.localPath);\n assert.equal(priorHash,hash(old));\n assert.equal(priorBytes,old.length);\n assert.equal(currentHash,hash(contents));\n assert.equal(currentBytes,contents.length);\n if(item.language===\"original\")assert.deepEqual(old,contents);\n if(priorHash!==currentHash)localChanged++;\n}\nconsole.log(JSON.stringify({revision,files:current.size,localChanged,originalFiles:15,koreanFiles:186,sourceMetadataUnchanged:true}));\n",

        "--eval",
        "\nimport assert from 'node:assert/strict';\nimport {readFile} from 'node:fs/promises';\nimport {createHash} from 'node:crypto';\nimport {readWork,authorizationDigest} from './scripts/workflow/work.ts';\nconst root=process.argv[1], childId=process.argv[2], parentId=process.argv[3], traceFile=process.argv[4];\nconst sha=value=>createHash('sha256').update(value).digest('hex');\nconst baseline=await readFile(root+'/baseline-proof.md','utf8');\nconst review=await readFile(root+'/current-review.md','utf8');\nconst heading=review.indexOf('## 18개실제교정과원문문맥');\nassert.notEqual(heading,-1);\nconst start=review.indexOf('{',heading), end=review.indexOf('\\n}',start);\nconst {patches}=JSON.parse(review.slice(start,end+2));\nassert.equal(patches.length,18);\nconst fence=String.fromCharCode(96).repeat(4);\nconst sections=new RegExp('^## (skill-library/[^\\\\n]+) — before SHA ([0-9a-f]{64})\\\\n\\\\n'+fence+'\\\\n(.*?)^'+fence+'$','gms');\nconst seen=new Set();\nlet applied=0;\nconst files=[];\nfor(const match of baseline.matchAll(sections)){\n const [,file,digest,display]=match;\n assert(!seen.has(file));\n seen.add(file);\n const actual=await readFile(file);\n let source=display;\n if(file.endsWith('/capy-pr.md')){\n  const displayed=source.split('\\n').find(line=>line.includes('[<caption>]'));\n  const literal=actual.toString('utf8').split('\\n').find(line=>line.includes('[<caption>]'));\n  assert(displayed&&literal&&displayed!==literal);\n  source=source.replace(displayed,literal);\n }\n const originals=[source,source.endsWith('\\n')?source.slice(0,-1):source];\n const original=originals.find(bytes=>sha(bytes)===digest);\n assert(original!==undefined,'교정 전 저장 지문과 다릅니다: '+file);\n let replaced=original;\n for(const patch of patches.filter(row=>row.path===file)){\n  assert.equal(patch.sha256,digest);\n  assert.equal(replaced.split(patch.old).length,2);\n  replaced=replaced.replace(patch.old,patch.new);\n  applied++;\n }\n assert.deepEqual(Buffer.from(replaced),actual,'현재 파일에 교정 이외 차이가 있습니다: '+file);\n files.push({file,beforeSha256:digest,currentSha256:sha(actual)});\n}\nassert.equal(seen.size,7);\nassert.equal(applied,18);\nconst evidence=JSON.parse(await readFile(traceFile,'utf8'));\nconst child=(await readWork({workId:childId})).record;\nconst parent=(await readWork({workId:parentId})).record;\nassert.equal(evidence.child,child.id);\nassert.equal(evidence.parent,parent.id);\nassert(child.relations.some(edge=>edge.type==='relates_to'&&edge.target===parent.id));\nassert.equal(authorizationDigest(parent.workflow.authorization),evidence.parentAuthorizationDigest);\nassert.deepEqual(parent.workflow.authorization.verifierCommands,evidence.parentApprovalCommands);\nassert(evidence.parentFailures.length>0&&evidence.childFailures.length>0);\nfor(const [work,list] of [[parent,evidence.parentFailures],[child,evidence.childFailures]]){\n const retained=new Set(work.workflow.verifications.filter(row=>row.result==='failed').map(row=>row.id));\n assert(list.every(id=>retained.has(id)));\n}\nconsole.log(JSON.stringify({applied,files,parent:parent.id,child:child.id,priorParentFailures:evidence.parentFailures.length,priorChildFailures:evidence.childFailures.length}));\n",

sha=value=>createHash('sha256').update(value).digest('hex');\nconst baseline=await readFile(root+'/baseline-proof.md','utf8');\nconst review=await readFile(root+'/current-review.md','utf8');\nconst heading=review.indexOf('## 18개실제교정과원문문맥');\nassert.notEqual(heading,-1);\nconst start=review.indexOf('{',heading), end=review.indexOf('\\n}',start);\nconst {patches}=JSON.parse(review.slice(start,end+2));\nassert.equal(patches.length,18);\nconst fence=String.fromCharCode(96).repeat(4);\nconst sections=new RegExp('^## (skill-library/[^\\\\n]+) — before SHA ([0-9a-f]{64})\\\\n\\\\n'+fence+'\\\\n(.*?)^'+fence+'$','gms');\nconst seen=new Set();\nlet applied=0;\nconst files=[];\nfor(const match of baseline.matchAll(sections)){\n const [,file,digest,display]=match;\n assert(!seen.has(file));\n seen.add(file);\n const actual=await readFile(file);\n let source=display;\n if(file.endsWith('/capy-pr.md')){\n  const displayed=source.split('\\n').find(line=>line.includes('[<caption>]'));\n  const literal=actual.toString('utf8').split('\\n').find(line=>line.includes('[<caption>]'));\n  assert(displayed&&literal&&displayed!==literal);\n  source=source.replace(displayed,literal);\n }\n const originals=[source,source.endsWith('\\n')?source.slice(0,-1):source];\n const original=originals.find(bytes=>sha(bytes)===digest);\n assert(original!==undefined,'교정 전 저장 지문과 다릅니다: '+file);\n let replaced=original;\n for(const patch of patches.filter(row=>row.path===file)){\n  assert.equal(patch.sha256,digest);\n  assert.equal(replaced.split(patch.old).length,2);\n  replaced=replaced.replace(patch.old,patch.new);\n  applied++;\n }\n assert.deepEqual(Buffer.from(replaced),actual,'현재 파일에 교정 이외 차이가 있습니다: '+file);\n files.push({file,beforeSha256:digest,currentSha256:sha(actual)});\n}\nassert.equal(seen.size,7);\nassert.equal(applied,18);\nconst evidence=JSON.parse(await readFile(traceFile,'utf8'));\nconst child=(await readWork({workId:childId})).record;\nconst parent=(await readWork({workId:parentId})).record;\nassert.equal(evidence.child,child.id);\nassert.equal(evidence.parent,parent.id);\nassert(child.relations.some(edge=>edge.type==='relates_to'&&edge.target===parent.id));\nassert.equal(authorizationDigest(parent.workflow.authorization),evidence.parentAuthorizationDigest);\nassert.deepEqual(parent.workflow.authorization.verifierCommands,evidence.parentApprovalCommands);\nassert(evidence.parentFailures.length>0);\nassert(child.workflow.reviews.some(item=>item.id==='review-4b391d30-fbff-44ab-a3b0-65752557b70a'&&item.verdict==='fail'));\nfor(const [work,list] of [[parent,evidence.parentFailures],[child,evidence.childFailures]]){\n const retained=new Set(work.workflow.verifications.filter(row=>row.result==='failed').map(row=>row.id));\n assert(list.every(id=>retained.has(id)));\n}\nconsole.log(JSON.stringify({applied,files,parent:parent.id,child:child.id,priorParentFailures:evidence.parentFailures.length,priorChildFailures:evidence.childFailures.length}));\n",

        "--eval",
        "\nimport assert from 'node:assert/strict';\nimport {readFile} from 'node:fs/promises';\nimport {createHash} from 'node:crypto';\nimport {readWork,authorizationDigest} from './scripts/workflow/work.ts';\nconst root=process.argv[1], childId=process.argv[2], parentId=process.argv[3], traceFile=process.argv[4];\nconst sha=value=>createHash('sha256').update(value).digest('hex');\nconst baseline=await readFile(root+'/baseline-proof.md','utf8');\nconst review=await readFile(root+'/current-review.md','utf8');\nconst heading=review.indexOf('## 18개실제교정과원문문맥');\nassert.notEqual(heading,-1);\nconst start=review.indexOf('{',heading), end=review.indexOf('\\n}',start);\nconst {patches}=JSON.parse(review.slice(start,end+2));\nassert.equal(patches.length,18);\nconst fence=String.fromCharCode(96).repeat(4);\nconst sections=new RegExp('^## (skill-library/[^\\\\n]+) — before SHA ([0-9a-f]{64})\\\\n\\\\n'+fence+'\\\\n(.*?)^'+fence+'$','gms');\nconst seen=new Set();\nlet applied=0;\nconst files=[];\nfor(const match of baseline.matchAll(sections)){\n const [,file,digest,display]=match;\n assert(!seen.has(file));\n seen.add(file);\n const actual=await readFile(file);\n let source=display;\n if(file.endsWith('/capy-pr.md')){\n  const displayed=source.split('\\n').find(line=>line.includes('[<caption>]'));\n  const literal=actual.toString('utf8').split('\\n').find(line=>line.includes('[<caption>]'));\n  assert(displayed&&literal&&displayed!==literal);\n  source=source.replace(displayed,literal);\n }\n const originals=[source,source.endsWith('\\n')?source.slice(0,-1):source];\n const original=originals.find(bytes=>sha(bytes)===digest);\n assert(original!==undefined,'교정 전 저장 지문과 다릅니다: '+file);\n let replaced=original;\n for(const patch of patches.filter(row=>row.path===file)){\n  assert.equal(patch.sha256,digest);\n  assert.equal(replaced.split(patch.old).length,2);\n  replaced=replaced.replace(patch.old,patch.new);\n  applied++;\n }\n assert.deepEqual(Buffer.from(replaced),actual,'현재 파일에 교정 이외 차이가 있습니다: '+file);\n files.push({file,beforeSha256:digest,currentSha256:sha(actual)});\n}\nassert.equal(seen.size,7);\nassert.equal(applied,18);\nconst evidence=JSON.parse(await readFile(traceFile,'utf8'));\nconst child=(await readWork({workId:childId})).record;\nconst parent=(await readWork({workId:parentId})).record;\nassert.equal(evidence.child,child.id);\nassert.equal(evidence.parent,parent.id);\nassert(child.relations.some(edge=>edge.type==='relates_to'&&edge.target===parent.id));\nassert.equal(authorizationDigest(parent.workflow.authorization),evidence.parentAuthorizationDigest);\nassert.deepEqual(parent.workflow.authorization.verifierCommands,evidence.parentApprovalCommands);\nassert(evidence.parentFailures.length>0&&evidence.childFailures.length>0);\nfor(const [work,list] of [[parent,evidence.parentFailures],[child,evidence.childFailures]]){\n const retained=new Set(work.workflow.verifications.filter(row=>row.result==='failed').map(row=>row.id));\n assert(list.every(id=>retained.has(id)));\n}\nconsole.log(JSON.stringify({applied,files,parent:parent.id,child:child.id,priorParentFailures:evidence.parentFailures.length,priorChildFailures:evidence.childFailures.length}));\n",

선별된 문구에 원문과 다른 의미가 있었고 부모 승인 및 과거 결과 기록을 계속 추적해야 했다. 검증 스크립트가 고정된 원문과 변경 전 지문, 현재 교정, 부모 작업의 변경 없는 승인과 실패 이력을 대조한다.

        "\nimport assert from 'node:assert/strict';\nimport {readFile} from 'node:fs/promises';\nimport {createHash} from 'node:crypto';\nimport {readWork,authorizationDigest} from './scripts/workflow/work.ts';\nconst root=process.argv[1], childId=process.argv[2], parentId=process.argv[3], traceFile=process.argv[4];\nconst sha=value=>createHash('sha256').update(value).digest('hex');\nconst baseline=await readFile(root+'/baseline-proof.md','utf8');\nconst review=await readFile(root+'/current-review.md','utf8');\nconst heading=review.indexOf('## 18개실제교정과원문문맥');\nassert.notEqual(heading,-1);\nconst start=review.indexOf('{',heading), end=review.indexOf('\\n}',start);\nconst {patches}=JSON.parse(review.slice(start,end+2));\nassert.equal(patches.length,18);\nconst fence=String.fromCharCode(96).repeat(4);\nconst sections=new RegExp('^## (skill-library/[^\\\\n]+) — before SHA ([0-9a-f]{64})\\\\n\\\\n'+fence+'\\\\n(.*?)^'+fence+'$','gms');\nconst seen=new Set();\nlet applied=0;\nconst files=[];\nfor(const match of baseline.matchAll(sections)){\n const [,file,digest,display]=match;\n assert(!seen.has(file));\n seen.add(file);\n const actual=await readFile(file);\n let source=display;\n if(file.endsWith('/capy-pr.md')){\n  const displayed=source.split('\\n').find(line=>line.includes('[<caption>]'));\n  const literal=actual.toString('utf8').split('\\n').find(line=>line.includes('[<caption>]'));\n  assert(displayed&&literal&&displayed!==literal);\n  source=source.replace(displayed,literal);\n }\n const originals=[source,source.endsWith('\\n')?source.slice(0,-1):source];\n const original=originals.find(bytes=>sha(bytes)===digest);\n assert(original!==undefined,'교정 전 저장 지문과 다릅니다: '+file);\n let replaced=original;\n for(const patch of patches.filter(row=>row.path===file)){\n  assert.equal(patch.sha256,digest);\n  assert.equal(replaced.split(patch.old).length,2);\n  replaced=replaced.replace(patch.old,patch.new);\n  applied++;\n }\n assert.deepEqual(Buffer.from(replaced),actual,'현재 파일에 교정 이외 차이가 있습니다: '+file);\n files.push({file,beforeSha256:digest,currentSha256:sha(actual)});\n}\nassert.equal(seen.size,7);\nassert.equal(applied,18);\nconst evidence=JSON.parse(await readFile(traceFile,'utf8'));\nconst child=(await readWork({workId:childId})).record;\nconst parent=(await readWork({workId:parentId})).record;\nassert.equal(evidence.child,child.id);\nassert.equal(evidence.parent,parent.id);\nassert(child.relations.some(edge=>edge.type==='relates_to'&&edge.target===parent.id));\nassert.equal(authorizationDigest(parent.workflow.authorization),evidence.parentAuthorizationDigest);\nassert.deepEqual(parent.workflow.authorization.verifierCommands,evidence.parentApprovalCommands);\nassert(evidence.parentFailures.length>0&&evidence.childFailures.length>0);\nfor(const [work,list] of [[parent,evidence.parentFailures],[child,evidence.childFailures]]){\n const retained=new Set(work.workflow.verifications.filter(row=>row.result==='failed').map(row=>row.id));\n assert(list.every(id=>retained.has(id)));\n}\nconsole.log(JSON.stringify({applied,files,parent:parent.id,child:child.id,priorParentFailures:evidence.parentFailures.length,priorChildFailures:evidence.childFailures.length}));\n",

'./scripts/workflow/work.ts';\nconst root=process.argv[1], childId=process.argv[2], parentId=process.argv[3], traceFile=process.argv[4];\nconst sha=value=>createHash('sha256').update(value).digest('hex');\nconst baseline=await readFile(root+'/baseline-proof.md','utf8');\nconst review=await readFile(root+'/current-review.md','utf8');\nconst heading=review.indexOf('## 18개실제교정과원문문맥');\nassert.notEqual(heading,-1);\nconst start=review.indexOf('{',heading), end=review.indexOf('\\n}',start);\nconst {patches}=JSON.parse(review.slice(start,end+2));\nassert.equal(patches.length,18);\nconst fence=String.fromCharCode(96).repeat(4);\nconst sections=new RegExp('^## (skill-library/[^\\\\n]+) — before SHA ([0-9a-f]{64})\\\\n\\\\n'+fence+'\\\\n(.*?)^'+fence+'$','gms');\nconst seen=new Set();\nlet applied=0;\nconst files=[];\nfor(const match of baseline.matchAll(sections)){\n const [,file,digest,display]=match;\n assert(!seen.has(file));\n seen.add(file);\n const actual=await readFile(file);\n let source=display;\n if(file.endsWith('/capy-pr.md')){\n  const displayed=source.split('\\n').find(line=>line.includes('[<caption>]'));\n  const literal=actual.toString('utf8').split('\\n').find(line=>line.includes('[<caption>]'));\n  assert(displayed&&literal&&displayed!==literal);\n  source=source.replace(displayed,literal);\n }\n const originals=[source,source.endsWith('\\n')?source.slice(0,-1):source];\n const original=originals.find(bytes=>sha(bytes)===digest);\n assert(original!==undefined,'교정 전 저장 지문과 다릅니다: '+file);\n let replaced=original;\n for(const patch of patches.filter(row=>row.path===file)){\n  assert.equal(patch.sha256,digest);\n  assert.equal(replaced.split(patch.old).length,2);\n  replaced=replaced.replace(patch.old,patch.new);\n  applied++;\n }\n assert.deepEqual(Buffer.from(replaced),actual,'현재 파일에 교정 이외 차이가 있습니다: '+file);\n files.push({file,beforeSha256:digest,currentSha256:sha(actual)});\n}\nassert.equal(seen.size,7);\nassert.equal(applied,18);\nconst evidence=JSON.parse(await readFile(traceFile,'utf8'));\nconst child=(await readWork({workId:childId})).record;\nconst parent=(await readWork({workId:parentId})).record;\nassert.equal(evidence.child,child.id);\nassert.equal(evidence.parent,parent.id);\nassert(child.relations.some(edge=>edge.type==='relates_to'&&edge.target===parent.id));\nassert.equal(authorizationDigest(parent.workflow.authorization),evidence.parentAuthorizationDigest);\nassert.deepEqual(parent.workflow.authorization.verifierCommands,evidence.parentApprovalCommands);\nassert(evidence.parentFailures.length>0);\nassert(child.workflow.reviews.some(item=>item.id==='review-4b391d30-fbff-44ab-a3b0-65752557b70a'&&item.verdict==='fail'));\nfor(const [work,list] of [[parent,evidence.parentFailures],[child,evidence.childFailures]]){\n const retained=new Set(work.workflow.verifications.filter(row=>row.result==='failed').map(row=>row.id));\n assert(list.every(id=>retained.has(id)));\n}\nconsole.log(JSON.stringify({applied,files,parent:parent.id,child:child.id,priorParentFailures:evidence.parentFailures.length,priorChildFailures:evidence.childFailures.length}));\n",

        "--eval",
        "\nimport assert from 'node:assert/strict';\nimport {readFile} from 'node:fs/promises';\nimport {createHash} from 'node:crypto';\nimport {readWork,authorizationDigest} from './scripts/workflow/work.ts';\nconst root=process.argv[1], childId=process.argv[2], parentId=process.argv[3], traceFile=process.argv[4];\nconst sha=value=>createHash('sha256').update(value).digest('hex');\nconst baseline=await readFile(root+'/baseline-proof.md','utf8');\nconst review=await readFile(root+'/current-review.md','utf8');\nconst heading=review.indexOf('## 18개실제교정과원문문맥');\nassert.notEqual(heading,-1);\nconst start=review.indexOf('{',heading), end=review.indexOf('\\n}',start);\nconst {patches}=JSON.parse(review.slice(start,end+2));\nassert.equal(patches.length,18);\nconst fence=String.fromCharCode(96).repeat(4);\nconst sections=new RegExp('^## (skill-library/[^\\\\n]+) — before SHA ([0-9a-f]{64})\\\\n\\\\n'+fence+'\\\\n(.*?)^'+fence+'$','gms');\nconst seen=new Set();\nlet applied=0;\nconst files=[];\nfor(const match of baseline.matchAll(sections)){\n const [,file,digest,display]=match;\n assert(!seen.has(file));\n seen.add(file);\n const actual=await readFile(file);\n let source=display;\n if(file.endsWith('/capy-pr.md')){\n  const displayed=source.split('\\n').find(line=>line.includes('[<caption>]'));\n  const literal=actual.toString('utf8').split('\\n').find(line=>line.includes('[<caption>]'));\n  assert(displayed&&literal&&displayed!==literal);\n  source=source.replace(displayed,literal);\n }\n const originals=[source,source.endsWith('\\n')?source.slice(0,-1):source];\n const original=originals.find(bytes=>sha(bytes)===digest);\n assert(original!==undefined,'교정 전 저장 지문과 다릅니다: '+file);\n let replaced=original;\n for(const patch of patches.filter(row=>row.path===file)){\n  assert.equal(patch.sha256,digest);\n  assert.equal(replaced.split(patch.old).length,2);\n  replaced=replaced.replace(patch.old,patch.new);\n  applied++;\n }\n assert.deepEqual(Buffer.from(replaced),actual,'현재 파일에 교정 이외 차이가 있습니다: '+file);\n files.push({file,beforeSha256:digest,currentSha256:sha(actual)});\n}\nassert.equal(seen.size,7);\nassert.equal(applied,18);\nconst evidence=JSON.parse(await readFile(traceFile,'utf8'));\nconst child=(await readWork({workId:childId})).record;\nconst parent=(await readWork({workId:parentId})).record;\nassert.equal(evidence.child,child.id);\nassert.equal(evidence.parent,parent.id);\nassert(child.relations.some(edge=>edge.type==='relates_to'&&edge.target===parent.id));\nassert.equal(authorizationDigest(parent.workflow.authorization),evidence.parentAuthorizationDigest);\nassert.deepEqual(parent.workflow.authorization.verifierCommands,evidence.parentApprovalCommands);\nassert(evidence.parentFailures.length>0&&evidence.childFailures.length>0);\nfor(const [work,list] of [[parent,evidence.parentFailures],[child,evidence.childFailures]]){\n const retained=new Set(work.workflow.verifications.filter(row=>row.result==='failed').map(row=>row.id));\n assert(list.every(id=>retained.has(id)));\n}\nconsole.log(JSON.stringify({applied,files,parent:parent.id,child:child.id,priorParentFailures:evidence.parentFailures.length,priorChildFailures:evidence.childFailures.length}));\n",

'./scripts/workflow/work.ts';\nconst root=process.argv[1], childId=process.argv[2], parentId=process.argv[3], traceFile=process.argv[4];\nconst sha=value=>createHash('sha256').update(value).digest('hex');\nconst baseline=await readFile(root+'/baseline-proof.md','utf8');\nconst review=await readFile(root+'/current-review.md','utf8');\nconst heading=review.indexOf('## 18개실제교정과원문문맥');\nassert.notEqual(heading,-1);\nconst start=review.indexOf('{',heading), end=review.indexOf('\\n}',start);\nconst {patches}=JSON.parse(review.slice(start,end+2));\nassert.equal(patches.length,18);\nconst fence=String.fromCharCode(96).repeat(4);\nconst sections=new RegExp('^## (skill-library/[^\\\\n]+) — before SHA ([0-9a-f]{64})\\\\n\\\\n'+fence+'\\\\n(.*?)^'+fence+'$','gms');\nconst seen=new Set();\nlet applied=0;\nconst files=[];\nfor(const match of baseline.matchAll(sections)){\n const displayed=source.split('\\n').find(line=>line.includes('[<caption>]'));\n  const literal=actual.toString('utf8').split('\\n').find(line=>line.includes('[<caption>]'));\n  assert(displayed&&literal&&displayed!==literal);\n  source=source.replace(displayed,literal);\n }\n const originals=[source,source.endsWith('\\n')?source.slice(0,-1):source];\n const assert.equal(patch.sha256,digest);\n  assert.equal(replaced.split(patch.old).length,2);\n  replaced=replaced.replace(patch.old,patch.new);\n  applied++;\n }\n assert.deepEqual(Buffer.from(replaced),actual,'현재 파일에 교정 이외 차이가 있습니다: '+file);\n files.push({file,beforeSha256:digest,currentSha256:sha(actual)});\n}\nassert.equal(seen.size,7);\nassert.equal(applied,18);\nconst evidence=JSON.parse(await readFile(traceFile,'utf8'));\nconst assert(list.every(id=>retained.has(id)));\n}\nconsole.log(JSON.stringify({applied,files,parent:parent.id,child:child.id,priorParentFailures:evidence.parentFailures.length,priorChildFailures:evidence.childFailures.length}));\n",

sha=value=>createHash('sha256').update(value).digest('hex');\nconst baseline=await readFile(root+'/baseline-proof.md','utf8');\nconst review=await readFile(root+'/current-review.md','utf8');\nconst {patches}=JSON.parse(review.slice(start,end+2));\nassert.equal(patches.length,18);\nconst fence=String.fromCharCode(96).repeat(4);\nconst sections=new RegExp('^## (skill-library/[^\\\\n]+) — before 기존 W005 UUID와 실제 하위 저작·검증 근거를 관계로 연결하고 과거 실패와 승인 목록을 보존한다. 하위 작업의 PASS나 리뷰를 W005 완료로 복사하지 않는다.
당시 통과로 기록

무엇을 어떻게 확인했나요

당시 관측과 현재 적용성은 다릅니다. 발행 당시 기록입니다. 이 HTML 사본은 현재 파일 상태를 조회하지 않습니다.

구체적인 검증 대상·방법·기대·관측 설명이 기록되지 않았습니다. 명령이나 종료 코드만으로 사용자 행동을 확인했다고 추정하지 않습니다.

저장된 검사 이력의 당시 결과: 통과 17건, 실패 1건. 실제 프로세스 실행과 실제 모델·GUI·플랫폼 확인 범위는 각 검사 설명에서 구분합니다.

독립 검토

독립 검토: 미실행으로 기록 · 관측 모델 미확인.

남은 일과 해소 행동

차단 사항은 남아 있지만 구체적인 해소 행동이 기록되지 않았습니다.

판단을 되짚는 근거

목적이 연결된 추가 근거 설명은 기록되지 않았습니다.

        "\nimport assert from 'node:assert/strict';\nimport {readFile} from 'node:fs/promises';\nimport {createHash} from 'node:crypto';\nimport {readWork,authorizationDigest} from './scripts/workflow/work.ts';\nconst root=process.argv[1], childId=process.argv[2], parentId=process.argv[3], traceFile=process.argv[4];\nconst sha=value=>createHash('sha256').update(value).digest('hex');\nconst baseline=await readFile(root+'/baseline-proof.md','utf8');\nconst review=await readFile(root+'/current-review.md','utf8');\nconst heading=review.indexOf('## 18개실제교정과원문문맥');\nassert.notEqual(heading,-1);\nconst start=review.indexOf('{',heading), end=review.indexOf('\\n}',start);\nconst {patches}=JSON.parse(review.slice(start,end+2));\nassert.equal(patches.length,18);\nconst fence=String.fromCharCode(96).repeat(4);\nconst sections=new RegExp('^## (skill-library/[^\\\\n]+) — before SHA ([0-9a-f]{64})\\\\n\\\\n'+fence+'\\\\n(.*?)^'+fence+'$','gms');\nconst seen=new Set();\nlet applied=0;\nconst files=[];\nfor(const match of baseline.matchAll(sections)){\n const [,file,digest,display]=match;\n assert(!seen.has(file));\n seen.add(file);\n const actual=await readFile(file);\n let source=display;\n if(file.endsWith('/capy-pr.md')){\n  const displayed=source.split('\\n').find(line=>line.includes('[<caption>]'));\n  const literal=actual.toString('utf8').split('\\n').find(line=>line.includes('[<caption>]'));\n  assert(displayed&&literal&&displayed!==literal);\n  source=source.replace(displayed,literal);\n }\n const originals=[source,source.endsWith('\\n')?source.slice(0,-1):source];\n const original=originals.find(bytes=>sha(bytes)===digest);\n assert(original!==undefined,'교정 전 저장 지문과 다릅니다: '+file);\n let replaced=original;\n for(const patch of patches.filter(row=>row.path===file)){\n  assert.equal(patch.sha256,digest);\n  assert.equal(replaced.split(patch.old).length,2);\n  replaced=replaced.replace(patch.old,patch.new);\n  applied++;\n }\n assert.deepEqual(Buffer.from(replaced),actual,'현재 파일에 교정 이외 차이가 있습니다: '+file);\n files.push({file,beforeSha256:digest,currentSha256:sha(actual)});\n}\nassert.equal(seen.size,7);\nassert.equal(applied,18);\nconst evidence=JSON.parse(await readFile(traceFile,'utf8'));\nconst child=(await readWork({workId:childId})).record;\nconst parent=(await readWork({workId:parentId})).record;\nassert.equal(evidence.child,child.id);\nassert.equal(evidence.parent,parent.id);\nassert(child.relations.some(edge=>edge.type==='relates_to'&&edge.target===parent.id));\nassert.equal(authorizationDigest(parent.workflow.authorization),evidence.parentAuthorizationDigest);\nassert.deepEqual(parent.workflow.authorization.verifierCommands,evidence.parentApprovalCommands);\nassert(evidence.parentFailures.length>0&&evidence.childFailures.length>0);\nfor(const [work,list] of [[parent,evidence.parentFailures],[child,evidence.childFailures]]){\n const retained=new Set(work.workflow.verifications.filter(row=>row.result==='failed').map(row=>row.id));\n assert(list.every(id=>retained.has(id)));\n}\nconsole.log(JSON.stringify({applied,files,parent:parent.id,child:child.id,priorParentFailures:evidence.parentFailures.length,priorChildFailures:evidence.childFailures.length}));\n",

2026년 11월 23일 AM 4:31 · 작성자 보고서 · 선택 라이브러리의 18문구 재적용과 부모 작업 이력을 검사했다. 현재 inventory의 201개 원본 메타데이터가 Git에 고정한 inventory와 일치했다.

선택 라이브러리 잔여 의미 18문구 교정

각 기록의 상태·검사·근거는 저장 당시의 관측입니다. 현재 상태를 다시 검증한 결과가 아닙니다.

일부 원본 항목이 이 보고서에 보관되지 않았습니다.

기준 근거 전체 26개 중 24개 표시 (2개 제외). 더 넓은 기록은 근거의 작업 파일과 대조해야 합니다.

교정 재적용과 부모 작업을 라이브러리 무결성 검사에 함께 연결한 과거 기록이 있었다. 현재 세 기준을 실제로 검사하는 명령에 각각 연결하고, 원문 15개 바이트와 지문을 다시 계산했다.

  • 일곱 번역 파일에 대한 18문구 재적용 결과를 대조했다.
  • 원본 SHA-256과 바이트 수를 고정 Git inventory와 대조했다.
  • 과거 검사 결과와 현재 근거의 시점을 현재 검토 문서에 표시했다.

요구와 결과

구조화된 요구·결과 설명이 없어 저장된 수용 기준과 당시 상태를 그대로 보여 줍니다.

고정 원문과 현재 SHA에 결속한 7개 기존 한국어 문서의 18개 실질 의미 차이를 선별 교정하고 다른 본문은 보존한다.

      "args": [
        "--input-type=module",
        "--eval",
        "\nimport assert from 'node:assert/strict';\nimport {readFile} from 'node:fs/promises';\nimport {createHash} from 'node:crypto';\nimport {readWork,authorizationDigest} from './scripts/workflow/work.ts';\nconst root=process.argv[1], childId=process.argv[2], parentId=process.argv[3], traceFile=process.argv[4];\nconst sha=value=>createHash('sha256').update(value).digest('hex');\nconst baseline=await readFile(root+'/baseline-proof.md','utf8');\nconst review=await readFile(root+'/current-review.md','utf8');\nconst heading=review.indexOf('## 18개실제교정과원문문맥');\nassert.notEqual(heading,-1);\nconst start=review.indexOf('{',heading), end=review.indexOf('\\n}',start);\nconst {patches}=JSON.parse(review.slice(start,end+2));\nassert.equal(patches.length,18);\nconst fence=String.fromCharCode(96).repeat(4);\nconst sections=new RegExp('^## (skill-library/[^\\\\n]+) — before SHA ([0-9a-f]{64})\\\\n\\\\n'+fence+'\\\\n(.*?)^'+fence+'$','gms');\nconst seen=new Set();\nlet applied=0;\nconst files=[];\nfor(const match of baseline.matchAll(sections)){\n const [,file,digest,display]=match;\n assert(!seen.has(file));\n seen.add(file);\n const actual=await readFile(file);\n let source=display;\n if(file.endsWith('/capy-pr.md')){\n  const displayed=source.split('\\n').find(line=>line.includes('[<caption>]'));\n  const literal=actual.toString('utf8').split('\\n').find(line=>line.includes('[<caption>]'));\n  assert(displayed&&literal&&displayed!==literal);\n  source=source.replace(displayed,literal);\n }\n const originals=[source,source.endsWith('\\n')?source.slice(0,-1):source];\n const original=originals.find(bytes=>sha(bytes)===digest);\n assert(original!==undefined,'교정 전 저장 지문과 다릅니다: '+file);\n let replaced=original;\n for(const patch of patches.filter(row=>row.path===file)){\n  assert.equal(patch.sha256,digest);\n  assert.equal(replaced.split(patch.old).length,2);\n  replaced=replaced.replace(patch.old,patch.new);\n  applied++;\n }\n assert.deepEqual(Buffer.from(replaced),actual,'현재 파일에 교정 이외 차이가 있습니다: '+file);\n files.push({file,beforeSha256:digest,currentSha256:sha(actual)});\n}\nassert.equal(seen.size,7);\nassert.equal(applied,18);\nconst evidence=JSON.parse(await readFile(traceFile,'utf8'));\nconst child=(await readWork({workId:childId})).record;\nconst parent=(await readWork({workId:parentId})).record;\nassert.equal(evidence.child,child.id);\nassert.equal(evidence.parent,parent.id);\nassert(child.relations.some(edge=>edge.type==='relates_to'&&edge.target===parent.id));\nassert.equal(authorizationDigest(parent.workflow.authorization),evidence.parentAuthorizationDigest);\nassert.deepEqual(parent.workflow.authorization.verifierCommands,evidence.parentApprovalCommands);\nassert(evidence.parentFailures.length>0&&evidence.childFailures.length>0);\nfor(const [work,list] of [[parent,evidence.parentFailures],[child,evidence.childFailures]]){\n const retained=new Set(work.workflow.verifications.filter(row=>row.result==='failed').map(row=>row.id));\n assert(list.every(id=>retained.has(id)));\n}\nconsole.log(JSON.stringify({applied,files,parent:parent.id,child:child.id,priorParentFailures:evidence.parentFailures.length,priorChildFailures:evidence.childFailures.length}));\n",

        "\nimport assert from 'node:assert/strict';\nimport {readFile} from 'node:fs/promises';\nimport {createHash} from 'node:crypto';\nimport {readWork,authorizationDigest} from './scripts/workflow/work.ts';\nconst root=process.argv[1], childId=process.argv[2], parentId=process.argv[3], traceFile=process.argv[4];\nconst sha=value=>createHash('sha256').update(value).digest('hex');\nconst baseline=await readFile(root+'/baseline-proof.md','utf8');\nconst review=await readFile(root+'/current-review.md','utf8');\nconst heading=review.indexOf('## 18개실제교정과원문문맥');\nassert.notEqual(heading,-1);\nconst start=review.indexOf('{',heading), end=review.indexOf('\\n}',start);\nconst {patches}=JSON.parse(review.slice(start,end+2));\nassert.equal(patches.length,18);\nconst fence=String.fromCharCode(96).repeat(4);\nconst sections=new RegExp('^## (skill-library/[^\\\\n]+) — before SHA ([0-9a-f]{64})\\\\n\\\\n'+fence+'\\\\n(.*?)^'+fence+'$','gms');\nconst seen=new Set();\nlet applied=0;\nconst files=[];\nfor(const match of baseline.matchAll(sections)){\n const [,file,digest,display]=match;\n assert(!seen.has(file));\n seen.add(file);\n const actual=await readFile(file);\n let source=display;\n if(file.endsWith('/capy-pr.md')){\n  const displayed=source.split('\\n').find(line=>line.includes('[<caption>]'));\n  const literal=actual.toString('utf8').split('\\n').find(line=>line.includes('[<caption>]'));\n  assert(displayed&&literal&&displayed!==literal);\n  source=source.replace(displayed,literal);\n }\n const originals=[source,source.endsWith('\\n')?source.slice(0,-1):source];\n const original=originals.find(bytes=>sha(bytes)===digest);\n assert(original!==undefined,'교정 전 저장 지문과 다릅니다: '+file);\n let replaced=original;\n for(const patch of patches.filter(row=>row.path===file)){\n  assert.equal(patch.sha256,digest);\n  assert.equal(replaced.split(patch.old).length,2);\n  replaced=replaced.replace(patch.old,patch.new);\n  applied++;\n }\n assert.deepEqual(Buffer.from(replaced),actual,'현재 파일에 교정 이외 차이가 있습니다: '+file);\n files.push({file,beforeSha256:digest,currentSha256:sha(actual)});\n}\nassert.equal(seen.size,7);\nassert.equal(applied,18);\nconst evidence=JSON.parse(await readFile(traceFile,'utf8'));\nconst child=(await readWork({workId:childId})).record;\nconst parent=(await readWork({workId:parentId})).record;\nassert.equal(evidence.child,child.id);\nassert.equal(evidence.parent,parent.id);\nassert(child.relations.some(edge=>edge.type==='relates_to'&&edge.target===parent.id));\nassert.equal(authorizationDigest(parent.workflow.authorization),evidence.parentAuthorizationDigest);\nassert.deepEqual(parent.workflow.authorization.verifierCommands,evidence.parentApprovalCommands);\nassert(evidence.parentFailures.length>0&&evidence.childFailures.length>0);\nfor(const [work,list] of [[parent,evidence.parentFailures],[child,evidence.childFailures]]){\n const retained=new Set(work.workflow.verifications.filter(row=>row.result==='failed').map(row=>row.id));\n assert(list.every(id=>retained.has(id)));\n}\nconsole.log(JSON.stringify({applied,files,parent:parent.id,child:child.id,priorParentFailures:evidence.parentFailures.length,priorChildFailures:evidence.childFailures.length}));\n",

요구와 결과

구조화된 요구·결과 설명이 없어 저장된 수용 기준과 당시 상태를 그대로 보여 줍니다.

고정 원문과 현재 SHA에 결속한 7개 기존 한국어 문서의 18개 실질 의미 차이를 선별 교정하고 다른 본문은 보존한다.
당시 통과로 기록
선택 자료 201개와 한국어186·원문15, 원문 해시·크기·고정 출처 및 법문을 유지하고 변경된 로컬 해시·크기만 inventory에 반영한다. 코드 표지 오역 한 건은 원문의 diff 식별자로 복원한다.
당시 통과로 기록
기존 W005 UUID와 실제 하위 저작·검증 근거를 관계로 연결하고 과거 실패와 승인 목록을 보존한다. 하위 작업의 PASS나 리뷰를 W005 완료로 복사하지 않는다.
당시 통과로 기록

무엇을 어떻게 확인했나요

당시 관측과 현재 적용성은 다릅니다. 발행 당시 기록입니다. 이 HTML 사본은 현재 파일 상태를 조회하지 않습니다.

구체적인 검증 대상·방법·기대·관측 설명이 기록되지 않았습니다. 명령이나 종료 코드만으로 사용자 행동을 확인했다고 추정하지 않습니다.

저장된 검사 이력의 당시 결과: 통과 11건, 실패 1건. 실제 프로세스 실행과 실제 모델·GUI·플랫폼 확인 범위는 각 검사 설명에서 구분합니다.

독립 검토

독립 검토: 당시 수정 필요로 기록.

수정이 필요한 것으로 기록되어 후속 확인이 남아 있습니다. 지적 전문은 아래 원시 근거에서 확인할 수 있습니다.

'./scripts/workflow/work.ts';\nconst root=process.argv[1], childId=process.argv[2], parentId=process.argv[3], traceFile=process.argv[4];\nconst sha=value=>createHash('sha256').update(value).digest('hex');\nconst baseline=await readFile(root+'/baseline-proof.md','utf8');\nconst review=await readFile(root+'/current-review.md','utf8');\nconst heading=review.indexOf('## 18개실제교정과원문문맥');\nassert.notEqual(heading,-1);\nconst start=review.indexOf('{',heading), end=review.indexOf('\\n}',start);\nconst {patches}=JSON.parse(review.slice(start,end+2));\nassert.equal(patches.length,18);\nconst fence=String.fromCharCode(96).repeat(4);\nconst sections=new RegExp('^## (skill-library/[^\\\\n]+) — before SHA ([0-9a-f]{64})\\\\n\\\\n'+fence+'\\\\n(.*?)^'+fence+'$','gms');\nconst seen=new Set();\nlet applied=0;\nconst files=[];\nfor(const match of baseline.matchAll(sections)){\n const [,file,digest,display]=match;\n assert(!seen.has(file));\n seen.add(file);\n const actual=await readFile(file);\n let source=display;\n if(file.endsWith('/capy-pr.md')){\n  const displayed=source.split('\\n').find(line=>line.includes('[<caption>]'));\n  const literal=actual.toString('utf8').split('\\n').find(line=>line.includes('[<caption>]'));\n  assert(displayed&&literal&&displayed!==literal);\n  source=source.replace(displayed,literal);\n }\n const originals=[source,source.endsWith('\\n')?source.slice(0,-1):source];\n const original=originals.find(bytes=>sha(bytes)===digest);\n assert(original!==undefined,'교정 전 저장 지문과 다릅니다: '+file);\n let replaced=original;\n for(const patch of patches.filter(row=>row.path===file)){\n  assert.equal(patch.sha256,digest);\n  assert.equal(replaced.split(patch.old).length,2);\n  replaced=replaced.replace(patch.old,patch.new);\n  applied++;\n }\n assert.deepEqual(Buffer.from(replaced),actual,'현재 파일에 교정 이외 차이가 있습니다: '+file);\n files.push({file,beforeSha256:digest,currentSha256:sha(actual)});\n}\nassert.equal(seen.size,7);\nassert.equal(applied,18);\nconst evidence=JSON.parse(await readFile(traceFile,'utf8'));\nconst child=(await readWork({workId:childId})).record;\nconst parent=(await readWork({workId:parentId})).record;\nassert.equal(evidence.child,child.id);\nassert.equal(evidence.parent,parent.id);\nassert(child.relations.some(edge=>edge.type==='relates_to'&&edge.target===parent.id));\nassert.equal(authorizationDigest(parent.workflow.authorization),evidence.parentAuthorizationDigest);\nassert.deepEqual(parent.workflow.authorization.verifierCommands,evidence.parentApprovalCommands);\nassert(evidence.parentFailures.length>0&&evidence.childFailures.length>0);\nfor(const [work,list] of [[parent,evidence.parentFailures],[child,evidence.childFailures]]){\n const retained=new Set(work.workflow.verifications.filter(row=>row.result==='failed').map(row=>row.id));\n assert(list.every(id=>retained.has(id)));\n}\nconsole.log(JSON.stringify({applied,files,parent:parent.id,child:child.id,priorParentFailures:evidence.parentFailures.length,priorChildFailures:evidence.childFailures.length}));\n",

      "args": [
        "--input-type=module",
        "--eval",
        "\nimport assert from 'node:assert/strict';\nimport {readFile} from 'node:fs/promises';\nimport {createHash} from 'node:crypto';\nimport {readWork,authorizationDigest} from './scripts/workflow/work.ts';\nconst root=process.argv[1], childId=process.argv[2], parentId=process.argv[3], traceFile=process.argv[4];\nconst sha=value=>createHash('sha256').update(value).digest('hex');\nconst baseline=await readFile(root+'/baseline-proof.md','utf8');\nconst review=await readFile(root+'/current-review.md','utf8');\nconst heading=review.indexOf('## 18개실제교정과원문문맥');\nassert.notEqual(heading,-1);\nconst start=review.indexOf('{',heading), end=review.indexOf('\\n}',start);\nconst {patches}=JSON.parse(review.slice(start,end+2));\nassert.equal(patches.length,18);\nconst fence=String.fromCharCode(96).repeat(4);\nconst sections=new RegExp('^## (skill-library/[^\\\\n]+) — before SHA ([0-9a-f]{64})\\\\n\\\\n'+fence+'\\\\n(.*?)^'+fence+'$','gms');\nconst seen=new Set();\nlet applied=0;\nconst files=[];\nfor(const match of baseline.matchAll(sections)){\n const [,file,digest,display]=match;\n assert(!seen.has(file));\n seen.add(file);\n const actual=await readFile(file);\n let source=display;\n if(file.endsWith('/capy-pr.md')){\n  const displayed=source.split('\\n').find(line=>line.includes('[<caption>]'));\n  const literal=actual.toString('utf8').split('\\n').find(line=>line.includes('[<caption>]'));\n  assert(displayed&&literal&&displayed!==literal);\n  source=source.replace(displayed,literal);\n }\n const originals=[source,source.endsWith('\\n')?source.slice(0,-1):source];\n const original=originals.find(bytes=>sha(bytes)===digest);\n assert(original!==undefined,'교정 전 저장 지문과 다릅니다: '+file);\n let replaced=original;\n for(const patch of patches.filter(row=>row.path===file)){\n  assert.equal(patch.sha256,digest);\n  assert.equal(replaced.split(patch.old).length,2);\n  replaced=replaced.replace(patch.old,patch.new);\n  applied++;\n }\n assert.deepEqual(Buffer.from(replaced),actual,'현재 파일에 교정 이외 차이가 있습니다: '+file);\n files.push({file,beforeSha256:digest,currentSha256:sha(actual)});\n}\nassert.equal(seen.size,7);\nassert.equal(applied,18);\nconst evidence=JSON.parse(await readFile(traceFile,'utf8'));\nconst child=(await readWork({workId:childId})).record;\nconst parent=(await readWork({workId:parentId})).record;\nassert.equal(evidence.child,child.id);\nassert.equal(evidence.parent,parent.id);\nassert(child.relations.some(edge=>edge.type==='relates_to'&&edge.target===parent.id));\nassert.equal(authorizationDigest(parent.workflow.authorization),evidence.parentAuthorizationDigest);\nassert.deepEqual(parent.workflow.authorization.verifierCommands,evidence.parentApprovalCommands);\nassert(evidence.parentFailures.length>0&&evidence.childFailures.length>0);\nfor(const [work,list] of [[parent,evidence.parentFailures],[child,evidence.childFailures]]){\n const retained=new Set(work.workflow.verifications.filter(row=>row.result==='failed').map(row=>row.id));\n assert(list.every(id=>retained.has(id)));\n}\nconsole.log(JSON.stringify({applied,files,parent:parent.id,child:child.id,priorParentFailures:evidence.parentFailures.length,priorChildFailures:evidence.childFailures.length}));\n",

일반 무결성 명령과 계산 결과 파일을 함께 기록했으며 독립 검토가 이를 실행 범위의 불일치로 지적했다. 정식 별도 프로세스가 일곱 원본 지문, 18개 재적용과 현재 파일 바이트, 부모 UUID·허용 명령 및 과거 실패 이력을 검사한다. 라이브러리 집중 검사는 무결성 기준에 별도로 기록했다.

        "\nimport assert from 'node:assert/strict';\nimport {readFile} from 'node:fs/promises';\nimport {createHash} from 'node:crypto';\nimport {readWork,authorizationDigest} from './scripts/workflow/work.ts';\nconst root=process.argv[1], childId=process.argv[2], parentId=process.argv[3], traceFile=process.argv[4];\nconst sha=value=>createHash('sha256').update(value).digest('hex');\nconst baseline=await readFile(root+'/baseline-proof.md','utf8');\nconst review=await readFile(root+'/current-review.md','utf8');\nconst heading=review.indexOf('## 18개실제교정과원문문맥');\nassert.notEqual(heading,-1);\nconst start=review.indexOf('{',heading), end=review.indexOf('\\n}',start);\nconst {patches}=JSON.parse(review.slice(start,end+2));\nassert.equal(patches.length,18);\nconst fence=String.fromCharCode(96).repeat(4);\nconst sections=new RegExp('^## (skill-library/[^\\\\n]+) — before SHA ([0-9a-f]{64})\\\\n\\\\n'+fence+'\\\\n(.*?)^'+fence+'$','gms');\nconst seen=new Set();\nlet applied=0;\nconst files=[];\nfor(const match of baseline.matchAll(sections)){\n const [,file,digest,display]=match;\n assert(!seen.has(file));\n seen.add(file);\n const actual=await readFile(file);\n let source=display;\n if(file.endsWith('/capy-pr.md')){\n  const displayed=source.split('\\n').find(line=>line.includes('[<caption>]'));\n  const literal=actual.toString('utf8').split('\\n').find(line=>line.includes('[<caption>]'));\n  assert(displayed&&literal&&displayed!==literal);\n  source=source.replace(displayed,literal);\n }\n const originals=[source,source.endsWith('\\n')?source.slice(0,-1):source];\n const original=originals.find(bytes=>sha(bytes)===digest);\n assert(original!==undefined,'교정 전 저장 지문과 다릅니다: '+file);\n let replaced=original;\n for(const patch of patches.filter(row=>row.path===file)){\n  assert.equal(patch.sha256,digest);\n  assert.equal(replaced.split(patch.old).length,2);\n  replaced=replaced.replace(patch.old,patch.new);\n  applied++;\n }\n assert.deepEqual(Buffer.from(replaced),actual,'현재 파일에 교정 이외 차이가 있습니다: '+file);\n files.push({file,beforeSha256:digest,currentSha256:sha(actual)});\n}\nassert.equal(seen.size,7);\nassert.equal(applied,18);\nconst evidence=JSON.parse(await readFile(traceFile,'utf8'));\nconst child=(await readWork({workId:childId})).record;\nconst parent=(await readWork({workId:parentId})).record;\nassert.equal(evidence.child,child.id);\nassert.equal(evidence.parent,parent.id);\nassert(child.relations.some(edge=>edge.type==='relates_to'&&edge.target===parent.id));\nassert.equal(authorizationDigest(parent.workflow.authorization),evidence.parentAuthorizationDigest);\nassert.deepEqual(parent.workflow.authorization.verifierCommands,evidence.parentApprovalCommands);\nassert(evidence.parentFailures.length>0&&evidence.childFailures.length>0);\nfor(const [work,list] of [[parent,evidence.parentFailures],[child,evidence.childFailures]]){\n const retained=new Set(work.workflow.verifications.filter(row=>row.result==='failed').map(row=>row.id));\n assert(list.every(id=>retained.has(id)));\n}\nconsole.log(JSON.stringify({applied,files,parent:parent.id,child:child.id,priorParentFailures:evidence.parentFailures.length,priorChildFailures:evidence.childFailures.length}));\n",
